title: 3 Waste companies
description: Analysis of our customers' live data. The system only suggests; a person decides.

options.content: 🟢 **Live (ESP32):** [Site now](/d/smart-compactor) · [Pickups](/d/live-pickups) · [Money & CO₂](/d/live-money) · [Devices](/d/edge-live)   |   📊 **Analysis (all customers):** [1 Problems](/d/value-cockpit) · [2 Cost & weight](/d/cockpit-cost) · **● 3 Waste companies** · [4 Invoices](/d/cockpit-actions)

### Which waste company performs best?
**Lifts at ≥60 %** = emptied when the container was worth it and not left full. **Truck / weighbridge on time** = rated by a person after each lift (Pickups page). **Invoice lines correct** = lines that match the board's measurement and the customer's prices. Facts for contract talks, not blame — a sensor can be wrong too.

targets.rawSql: SELECT op AS "Waste company", round(on_time::numeric) AS "%" FROM (SELECT c.operator_name AS op, count(*) AS lifts, avg(CASE WHEN p.verdict = 'ON_TIME' THEN 100.0 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time, avg(p.load_before_pct) AS load, sum(CASE WHEN p.verdict = 'TOO_EARLY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS early, sum(CASE WHEN p.verdict = 'TOO_LATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN p.truck_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(count(p.truck_on_time), 0) AS truck_ok, count(p.truck_on_time) AS truck_n, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN p.weighbridge_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(count(p.weighbridge_on_time), 0) AS wb_ok, count(p.weighbridge_on_time) AS wb_n FROM pickups p JOIN compactors c ON c.id = p.compactor_id WHERE p.status = 'done' AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(p.done_at) GROUP BY 1) x ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT op AS "Waste company", round(lines_ok::numeric) AS "%" FROM (SELECT i.operator_name AS op, count(*) AS invoices, 100.0 * sum(i.lines_ok) / NULLIF(sum(i.lines_total), 0) AS lines_ok, sum(i.overcharged_eur) AS over, sum(i.unverified_eur) AS proof FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.* FROM invoice_decisions d JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM invoice_decisions GROUP BY invoice_id) m ON m.max_id = d.id) d ON d.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.customer_name IN ($customer) AND i.operator_name IN ($operator) GROUP BY 1) x ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT op AS "Waste company", round(over::numeric) AS "EUR" FROM (SELECT i.operator_name AS op, count(*) AS invoices, 100.0 * sum(i.lines_ok) / NULLIF(sum(i.lines_total), 0) AS lines_ok, sum(i.overcharged_eur) AS over, sum(i.unverified_eur) AS proof FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.* FROM invoice_decisions d JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM invoice_decisions GROUP BY invoice_id) m ON m.max_id = d.id) d ON d.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.customer_name IN ($customer) AND i.operator_name IN ($operator) GROUP BY 1) x ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Truck came on time (rated by a person)
panels.description: Share of rated lifts where the truck came when it was booked (Pickups page > Rate the waste company)

targets.rawSql: SELECT op AS "Waste company", round(truck_ok::numeric) AS "%" FROM (SELECT c.operator_name AS op, count(*) AS lifts, avg(CASE WHEN p.verdict = 'ON_TIME' THEN 100.0 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time, avg(p.load_before_pct) AS load, sum(CASE WHEN p.verdict = 'TOO_EARLY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS early, sum(CASE WHEN p.verdict = 'TOO_LATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN p.truck_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(count(p.truck_on_time), 0) AS truck_ok, count(p.truck_on_time) AS truck_n, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN p.weighbridge_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(count(p.weighbridge_on_time), 0) AS wb_ok, count(p.weighbridge_on_time) AS wb_n FROM pickups p JOIN compactors c ON c.id = p.compactor_id WHERE p.status = 'done' AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(p.done_at) GROUP BY 1) x WHERE truck_n > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Weighbridge ticket on time (rated by a person)
panels.description: Share of rated lifts where the waste company sent its weighbridge ticket on time

targets.rawSql: SELECT op AS "Waste company", round(wb_ok::numeric) AS "%" FROM (SELECT c.operator_name AS op, count(*) AS lifts, avg(CASE WHEN p.verdict = 'ON_TIME' THEN 100.0 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time, avg(p.load_before_pct) AS load, sum(CASE WHEN p.verdict = 'TOO_EARLY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS early, sum(CASE WHEN p.verdict = 'TOO_LATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN p.truck_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(count(p.truck_on_time), 0) AS truck_ok, count(p.truck_on_time) AS truck_n, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN p.weighbridge_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(count(p.weighbridge_on_time), 0) AS wb_ok, count(p.weighbridge_on_time) AS wb_n FROM pickups p JOIN compactors c ON c.id = p.compactor_id WHERE p.status = 'done' AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(p.done_at) GROUP BY 1) x WHERE wb_n > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT coalesce(a.op, b.op) AS "Waste company", a.lifts AS "Lifts", round(a.on_time::numeric) AS "At ≥60 % %", round(a.load::numeric) AS "Avg load at lift %", a.early AS "Too early", a.late AS "Left full 2h+", round(a.truck_ok::numeric) AS "Truck on time %", round(a.wb_ok::numeric) AS "Weighbridge on time %", a.truck_n AS "Rated", b.invoices AS "Invoices", round(b.lines_ok::numeric) AS "Lines correct %", round(b.over::numeric, 2) AS "Charged too much €", round(b.proof::numeric, 2) AS "Needs proof €" FROM (SELECT c.operator_name AS op, count(*) AS lifts, avg(CASE WHEN p.verdict = 'ON_TIME' THEN 100.0 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time, avg(p.load_before_pct) AS load, sum(CASE WHEN p.verdict = 'TOO_EARLY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS early, sum(CASE WHEN p.verdict = 'TOO_LATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN p.truck_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(count(p.truck_on_time), 0) AS truck_ok, count(p.truck_on_time) AS truck_n, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN p.weighbridge_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(count(p.weighbridge_on_time), 0) AS wb_ok, count(p.weighbridge_on_time) AS wb_n FROM pickups p JOIN compactors c ON c.id = p.compactor_id WHERE p.status = 'done' AND c.customer_name IN ($customer) AND c.operator_name IN ($operator) AND $__timeFilter(p.done_at) GROUP BY 1) a FULL JOIN (SELECT i.operator_name AS op, count(*) AS invoices, 100.0 * sum(i.lines_ok) / NULLIF(sum(i.lines_total), 0) AS lines_ok, sum(i.overcharged_eur) AS over, sum(i.unverified_eur) AS proof FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.* FROM invoice_decisions d JOIN (SELECT invoice_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM invoice_decisions GROUP BY invoice_id) m ON m.max_id = d.id) d ON d.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE i.customer_name IN ($customer) AND i.operator_name IN ($operator) GROUP BY 1) b ON b.op = a.op ORDER BY 1
